Regenerate from the TORCS runtime directory, in this order:
trackgen.exe -c test -n over-under-2 -z
trackgen.exe -c test -n over-under-2 -a -q
trackgen.exe -c test -n over-under-2 -r
accc.exe -g tracks/test/over-under-2/over-under-2.acc -l0 tracks/test/over-under-2/over-under-2.ac -l1 tracks/test/over-under-2/over-under-2-trk-raceline.ac -d3 1000 -d2 500 -d1 300 -S 300 -es
